# Bellandur Ganesha Utsava

> Official site for Bellandur Ganesha Utsava, the festival organisation for a five-day community Ganesha festival in Bellandur, Bengaluru. Sri Vinayaka Seva Mandali and Classic Boys came together to run it as one shared festival in one place, instead of separate celebrations on different roads.

The 2026 festival runs 14 to 18 September 2026 near Shri Venkateshwara Swamy Temple, 12th B Cross Rd, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103. Entry is free and open to everyone. Daily programmes include dance, music, camps, prasadam, and a grand procession on 18 September.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bgu.propage.in/): Festival overview, dates, daily programme, visit guidance, organisers, seva (UPI), and partners
- [Logo resources](https://bgu.propage.in/resources/): Official English and Kannada logo files for print and digital use
